description:
Write a python program using jupyter notebook which will predict the possible outcome of 3 balls to be picked from set of 26 balls.

3. Based on previous results each letter will be getting a percentage(to be picked up). Rules of percentage are as below
 a) if a ball has picked in immediate previous pick, the chance of getting that picked will be less.
 b) if a ball has not been picked in previous many results, the chance of getting that picked will be more.
 c)if a ball has been picked twice in a row(previous two pick), chance of getting that picked will be minium(least).
 d) specific ball, which has most picked in all previous(100) results will get less chance to be picked up
 e)specific ball which has been least picked up in all previous(100) results will get better chance to be picked up.

5. Though the order does not matter, the results are NOT in sorted order(in excel sheet) eg.

 RAT
TOM
PON
QAP
TAP
 Clearly the T,P,A is most occurring letter so the percentage for these letter will be lesser(and equal in this case, as all are 3 times occurring)
6. Program should auto improvise the results after learning the current result.
7. So, we need to have a way to insert the current output via data entry and should be updated in next ROW in excel sheet.
8. This way program does not have to stop and will be able to match predicted outcome vs the results.

6. local bundle adjustment (Ceres solver) for each individual measurement

4. Configuration and operational support of big data infrastructure to ensure high performance, availability and security.

Additional experience in the following areas is advantageous:

-To work with distributed machine learning and in particular federated learning
-Collection of user requirements to be translated into project and research activities

Technical competences:

-Knowledge of common deep learning frameworks (eg Tensorflow, Keras, numpy).
-Knowledge of programming techniques and languages: Python programming required; Knowledge of SQL, C# and Java is advantageous.

Behavioral Competencies:

-Solve problems: identify, define and assess problems, take action to solve them
-Achieving results: delivering high quality work on time and meeting expectations
-Work in teams: build and maintain constructive and effective working relationships
- Communicate effectively: deliver presentations in a structured and clear manner; adapt style and content to audience; answers questions calmly and confidently
- Learn and share knowledge: stay up-to-date with developments in your own area of expertise and easily absorb new information.
